content:
**Dirty Laundry** is a quest in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

To start this quest, the Vault Dweller has to pick up any case Abraxodyne Intel. They can be found at any and all of the below locations:

| Image | Location | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Ohio Sign.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/0/0d/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ohio_Sign.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ohio_Sign.webp) | On Highway 35, north of Checkpoint Canyon, next to the giant Welcome to Ohio Sign in the broken trunk of a rusted car. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Railroad Service Yard Under Desk.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/9/94/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Railroad_Service_Yard_Under_Desk.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Railroad_Service_Yard_Under_Desk.webp) | At the Railroad Service Yard, one is on the top floor of a small brick building under a desk. Another is in a corrugated metal barn on a shelf. A third can be found in the bigger brick building in an office that overlooks the building on a desk. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Railroad Service Yard Shed.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/2/23/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Railroad_Service_Yard_Shed.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Railroad_Service_Yard_Shed.webp) | At the Railroad Service Yard, another is in a corrugated metal barn on a shelf. A third can be found in the bigger brick building in an office that overlooks the building on a desk. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Railroad Service Yard Office.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/57/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Railroad_Service_Yard_Office.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Railroad_Service_Yard_Office.webp) | At the Railroad Service Yard, a third can be found in the bigger brick building in an office that overlooks the building on a desk. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Water Tower.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/4/45/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Water_Tower.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Water_Tower.webp) | At an unmarked water tower southwest of the Railroad Service Yard, one can be found on a wooden platform on the tower. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Water Tower Picnic.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/8/85/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Water_Tower_Picnic.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Water_Tower_Picnic.webp) | At an unmarked water tower southwest of the Railroad Service Yard, another is at a small seating area next to the water tower, under a picnic table with corrugated metal on top of it. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Wrecked Train.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/a5/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Wrecked_Train.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Wrecked_Train.webp) | Going south of the unmarked water tower and following the train tracks, one can be found at the end where a wrecked train is toppled over. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Meadow Breeze Storage Depot Tank.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/ac/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Meadow_Breeze_Storage_Depot_Tank.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Meadow_Breeze_Storage_Depot_Tank.webp) | At the Meadow Breeze Storage Depot, one is inside a tank trailer. The other is in a large wooden shed near some barrels. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Meadow Breeze Storage Depot Barn.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6b/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Meadow_Breeze_Storage_Depot_Barn.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Meadow_Breeze_Storage_Depot_Barn.webp) | At the Meadow Breeze Storage Depot, another is in a large wooden shed near some barrels. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Jackson Junkyard Shack.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/0/04/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Jackson_Junkyard_Shack.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Jackson_Junkyard_Shack.webp) | Jackson Junkyard has one in a broken down wooden shack that has the Admin Terminal inside. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Jackson Junkyard Truck.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/b/b8/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Jackson_Junkyard_Truck.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Jackson_Junkyard_Truck.webp) | Jackson Junkyard has another that can be found at the top of the hill in the back of a truck that is partially falling down the slope. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Overhang.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/3/3c/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Overhang.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Overhang.webp) | Slightly East of the Jackson Junkyard, one is in a shopping cart by a small rocky overhang turned into a makeshift camp. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Kitchen.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/ef/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Kitchen.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Kitchen.webp) | Going North of the Jackson Junkyard there is a small unmarked brick building that has an intel case under the table. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Abraxodyne Chemical Substation Shack.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/d/d1/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Abraxodyne_Chemical_Substation_Shack.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Abraxodyne_Chemical_Substation_Shack.webp) | One can be found at the Abraxodyne Chemical Power Substation in the corrugated metal shack. | 
| | One can be found at Sand Fork Lumber inside a broken down shed with crafting benches inside. It is next to the Weapons Workbench. | 
| | Southeast of Sand Fork Lumber there is an unmarked dry farmland with a skeleton holding the case while partially submerged in the dirt. | 
| | Southeast of The Rust Kingdom there is an unmarked house on a trailer trying to go through a tunnel at the end of the road. Inside the collapsed tunnel there is one case inside a rusted car. | 
| | Four can be found at Tycoon Lake. One in the shed of the Abraxodyne pump station at the top of the hill, which also gives the Vault Dweller the Meadow Breeze Sprayer. | 
| | At Tycoon Lake, another is in a metal camper on the North side of the lake. | 
| | At Tycoon Lake, one is in the same truck as the Note to Manny, on the west side of the lake on the road. | 
| | The last one at Tycoon Lake is up the dirt road leaning against a wooden log next to a motorcycle. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Fort Steuben Sign.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/c8/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Fort_Steuben_Sign.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Fort_Steuben_Sign.webp) | Two can be found at Fort Steuben. One can be found propped up against the Fort Steuben sign. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Fort Steuben Sandbag.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/1/1c/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Fort_Steuben_Sandbag.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Fort_Steuben_Sandbag.webp) | At Fort Steuben, the other is near an Eastern entrance behind a wall of sandbags. | 
| | South of Fort Steuben, in a small sitting area with a concession stand there is an intel case under the table with two skeletons. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Covered Bridge.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Covered_Bridge.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Covered_Bridge.webp) | South of Fort Steuben in an unmarked covered bridge there is one in the back of a rusty van. | 
| | Two at Westbrook Horse Ranch. One inside the barn, and the other under the front of the most southern Horse Trailer. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Westbrook Horse Ranch Trailer.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/4/48/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Westbrook_Horse_Ranch_Trailer.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Westbrook_Horse_Ranch_Trailer.webp) | At Westbrook Horse Ranch, the other is under the front of the most southern parked Horse Trailer. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Albany.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/7/78/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Albany.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Albany.webp) | One can be found at Albany in the same white house with a red door that has the Abraxodyne Cache inside. It is on the top floor on a metal shelf. | 
| ![FO76 Location The Chop Shop Red Rocket Intel 01.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6d/FO76_Location_The_Chop_Shop_Red_Rocket_Intel_01.webp/300px-FO76_Location_The_Chop_Shop_Red_Rocket_Intel_01.webp) | One at The Chop Shop, inside the Red Rocket, underneath a counter. | 
| ![FO76 Location The Chop Shop Red Rocket Intel 02.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/64/FO76_Location_The_Chop_Shop_Red_Rocket_Intel_02.webp/300px-FO76_Location_The_Chop_Shop_Red_Rocket_Intel_02.webp) | One at The Chop Shop, inside the Red Rocket, at the bloodied garage. | 
| ![FO76 Location The Chop Shop Shooting Range Intel.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/1/1e/FO76_Location_The_Chop_Shop_Shooting_Range_Intel.webp/300px-FO76_Location_The_Chop_Shop_Shooting_Range_Intel.webp) | One at The Chop Shop, at a nearby makeshift shooting range south of the trailer home, leaning against a wooden crate. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Oak Hill.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/f/f9/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Oak_Hill.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Oak_Hill.webp) | One can be found inside the Oak Hill unmarked Cathedral North of the Chop Shop, in the back left side on a shelf. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel North East of Oak Hill.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/3/36/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_North_East_of_Oak_Hill.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_North_East_of_Oak_Hill.webp) | One can be found North East of Oak Hill in an unmarked destroyed house on top of a set of stairs. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Starlight Drive-In Stairway.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/0/0f/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Starlight_Drive-In_Stairway.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Starlight_Drive-In_Stairway.webp) | Three can be found at Starlight Drive-In. One is the concession stand of the Starlight Drive-In, on the landing of the stairs between the first and second floor. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Starlight Drive-In Shed.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/b/bd/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Starlight_Drive-In_Shed.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Starlight_Drive-In_Shed.webp) | At the Starlight Drive-In, another is located on the shelf of a small metal shed behind the projector screen. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Starlight Drive-In Billboard.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/58/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Starlight_Drive-In_Billboard.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Starlight_Drive-In_Billboard.webp) | The third is case at the Starlight Drive-In is on the Attack of the Fishmen Billboard, which can be accessed by climbing the fallen tree that landed on it. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Prospect Hill Bench.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/66/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Prospect_Hill_Bench.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Prospect_Hill_Bench.webp) | Two can be found at Prospect Hill. One held by a skeleton next to a bench near some red viewfinders. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Prospect Hill Trailer.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/7/7c/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Prospect_Hill_Trailer.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Prospect_Hill_Trailer.webp) | The other at Prospect Hill is inside a metal trailer in a safe with no door. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Honey Well Apiary.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/53/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Honey_Well_Apiary.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Honey_Well_Apiary.webp) | One can be found at the bottom of the hill of Honey Well Apiary, in the planter box next to the shed. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Hocking Hills Station Interior.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6d/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Hocking_Hills_Station_Interior.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Hocking_Hills_Station_Interior.webp) | Two can be found Hocking Hills Station. One is inside the building, on a bench next to some take-out containers. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Hocking Hills Station Train Car.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/4/4c/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Hocking_Hills_Station_Train_Car.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Hocking_Hills_Station_Train_Car.webp) | The other at Hocking Hills Station is on the East side of the station, in a tipped over orange train car. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel North of Hocking Hills Station.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/8/81/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_North_of_Hocking_Hills_Station.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_North_of_Hocking_Hills_Station.webp) | Going North of Hocking Hills Station, there is one in a collapsed car tunnel. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel South of Hocking Hills Station.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/5a/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_South_of_Hocking_Hills_Station.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_South_of_Hocking_Hills_Station.webp) | Two can be found South of the Hocking Hills Station. One in a Nuka-Cherry themed bathroom on the ladies side. | 
| | The other South of Hocking Hills Station is in the dugout of the baseball diamond. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Doghouse.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/a4/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Doghouse.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Doghouse.webp) | Going even farther South of Hocking Hills Station, one can be found in a doghouse next to an unmarked building. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Locked Shed.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/b/bf/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Locked_Shed.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Locked_Shed.webp) | One can be found halfway between Hocking Hills Station and the World of Corn, in a locked shed behind a metal camper. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Van.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/54/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Van.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Van.webp) | On top of a hill Southwest of the above locked shed unmarked location, there is a rusty hollowed out van that has one case in the back. | 
| | West of the World of Corn, one can be found under a playground. | 
| | South of the World of Corn, there is a fallen down tree with an intel case hidden underneath. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel World of Corn.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/8/83/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_World_of_Corn.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_World_of_Corn.webp) | One can be found inside the building at the World of Corn in a room marked "Employees Only." It is under the desk that has the World of Corn Administrator Terminal on it. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Sandy's Sock Hop.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/eb/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Sandy%27s_Sock_Hop.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Sandy%27s_Sock_Hop.webp) | One can be found at Sandy's Sock Hop behind the counter with the broken soda machines. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Ash Cave Top of Hill.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/8/8a/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ash_Cave_Top_of_Hill.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ash_Cave_Top_of_Hill.webp) | Two can be found at the Ash Cave. One can be found at the top of the hill of the near the ramp of a windmill. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Ash Cave Hocking Hills Station Bathroom.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/d/d2/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ash_Cave_Hocking_Hills_Station_Bathroom.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ash_Cave_Hocking_Hills_Station_Bathroom.webp) | Before entering the Ash Cave, there is a small Ash Cave Hocking Hills Station, with an Intel case next to a Nuka-Cola Machine near the bathroom. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Ash Cave Metal Shack.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/9/9f/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ash_Cave_Metal_Shack.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Ash_Cave_Metal_Shack.webp) | The other at the Ash Cave is at the bottom of a hill just outside of a metal shack next to some barrels. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Shade Hill Church.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/d/d8/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Shade_Hill_Church.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Shade_Hill_Church.webp) | One can be found at Shade Hill Church, being held by a skeleton in a pew. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Super Duper Mart.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/f/fd/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Super_Duper_Mart.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Super_Duper_Mart.webp) | One can be found inside the Super Duper Mart on a shelf with some pre-war food. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel South of Dino Peaks Bathtub.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/57/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_South_of_Dino_Peaks_Bathtub.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_South_of_Dino_Peaks_Bathtub.webp) | Two can be found Southwest of Dino Peaks Mini Golf in some unmarked buildings. One is in the bathtub of the basement of a run down building. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel South of Dino Peaks Skeleton.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/b/bc/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_South_of_Dino_Peaks_Skeleton.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_South_of_Dino_Peaks_Skeleton.webp) | The other case that is Southwest of Dino Peaks Mini Gold is between the legs of a skeleton sitting on the porch of a small cottage. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Dino Peaks Mini Golf Dumpster.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/1/12/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Dumpster.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Dumpster.webp) | Three can be found at Dino Peaks Mini Golf. One is behind the Dino Diner, in a dumpster. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Dino Peaks Mini Golf Shed.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/5/52/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Shed.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Shed.webp) | Another Intel Case in Dino Peaks is west of Hole 5, in a shed. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Dino Peaks Mini Golf Concessions.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/4/47/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Concessions.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Concessions.webp) | The third Intel case that is located in Dino Peaks is in the small "FOOD" concession stand, to the right of Hole 8. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel East of Dino Peaks Mini Golf Unmarked Church.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/c2/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_East_of_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Unmarked_Church.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_East_of_Dino_Peaks_Mini_Golf_Unmarked_Church.webp) | One can be found East of the Dino Peaks Mini Golf on top of a hill, in a small white unmarked church. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Red Shed.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/d/d5/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Red_Shed.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Red_Shed.webp) | One can be found North of Dino Peaks Mini Golf in a red unmarked shed near a small house with a porch. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel End of Railroad Line.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/f/f1/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_End_of_Railroad_Line.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_End_of_Railroad_Line.webp) | One can be found farther North of Dino Peaks Mini Golf at the end of the railroad line, inside the collapsed tunnel. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Pebbles the Cat Museum.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/1/16/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Pebbles_the_Cat_Museum.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Pebbles_the_Cat_Museum.webp) | One can be found West of Dino Peaks Mini Golf at the unmarked Pebbles the Cat Museum in the employees only shed. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Unmarked Train Tower.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/f/f7/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Train_Tower.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Unmarked_Train_Tower.webp) | One can be found North of the Pebbles the Cat Museum inside an unmarked white train tower next to the desk. | 
| | One can be found on an upturned boat, at the northernmost part of the map, at the unmarked body of water. | 
| | Seven can be found at or around Athens. One can be found just before the south entrance to Athens in a red storage container along the road. | 
| | Continuing with Athens, one can be found by crossing the red bridge with railroad tracks on it to a small island with a cottage. It is leaning up against the cottage with some crates. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Athens Armory.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/7/7f/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Armory.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Armory.webp) | One can be be found behind the Athens Armory in a metal shack between two shelves. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Athens Pub.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/7/7a/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Pub.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Pub.webp) | Near a brick "PUB" building in Athens, an Intel case is held by a skeleton on the side of the building next to an Abraxo advertisement. | 
| ![FO76 Location Athens Barber Shop 07.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/4/4d/FO76_Location_Athens_Barber_Shop_07.webp/300px-FO76_Location_Athens_Barber_Shop_07.webp) | Crossing the bridge near the above Intel case, one can be found inside a building which can be entered through a hole in the wall. Taking a right, the case is in the kitchen on the counter. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Athens Backstage.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/c/c6/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Backstage.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Backstage.webp) | One is across the street from the Abraxodyne Office on the "Welcome to Athens Halloween!" stage in the back. | 
| ![FO76 BuSp Abraxodyne Intel Athens Basketball Court.webp](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/f/f2/FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Basketball_Court.webp/300px-FO76_BuSp_Abraxodyne_Intel_Athens_Basketball_Court.webp) | Behind the Abraxodyne Office there is a basketball court where a case can be found leaning up against a lamp post. |

After picking up any Intel case, the Vault Dweller can travel to Athens and enter the Abraxodyne Office where they will meet Bodhi. Bohdi is searching for these Intel cases in order to find out more information about his daughter, Amrita, who has gone missing. Bodhi will offer you rewards, including the Abraxodyne Tapes, for the more Intel cases you bring him. On Abraxodyne Tape 10, Vault Dweller will start to receive the radial locations of the Abraxodyne Caches.

Once the Vault Dweller receives the Abraxodyne Tape 15 Bodhi will reveal that a hitman was sent to kill Amrita, who was a whistleblower on Abraxodyne's Meadow Breeze project, and asks you to go the apartment where the hitman was supposed to collect their gear for the assassination. Entering the trap littered apartment, the Vault Dweller meets The Exec, who is a ghoulified former member of Abraxodyne Chemical's board. He admits to having Amrita assassinated and can either offer the Vault Dweller caps to keep quiet or can be killed.

The Vault Dweller can return to Bodhi and tell him of The Exec's fate, in which he will choose to no longer stay at Athens. Before he leaves he shows the Vault Dweller how to open and decrypt the Abraxodyne cases themself.
